summary: Tested currency selector and legal pages redesign. All features working correctly: Currency selector in header with USD/EUR/GBP/CAD/AUD options, note about payments in USD, price conversion with ~ prefix for non-USD currencies, localStorage persistence. Legal pages (Terms, Privacy, Refunds) have new collapsible accordion design with gradient heroes and icons.
critical_code_review_comments: CurrencySelector.tsx: Well-implemented with compact mode for header, full mode for settings. Uses localStorage for persistence and custom 'currencyChanged' event for cross-component updates.
currencyService.ts: Good implementation with IP detection (ip-api.com) and browser geolocation fallback. Static exchange rates (EUR: 0.92, GBP: 0.79, CAD: 1.36, AUD: 1.53).
PriceDisplay component (UI.tsx lines 825-886): Correctly reads from localStorage and listens for 'currencyChanged' events. Shows ~ prefix for non-USD currencies.
Terms.tsx: Violet/purple gradient hero with collapsible Section components and icons. Quick links to Privacy and Refunds.
PrivacyPolicy.tsx: Emerald/teal gradient hero with 'Your Privacy Matters' summary card. Collapsible sections with icons.
RefundsPage.tsx: Orange gradient hero with numbered steps (1-2-3), FAQ section with collapsible accordions, 'Important: Organizer-Set Policies' notice.
